## Intent

**Problem:** Synthesis in Lumina does not compound. A topic page is a snapshot that is regenerated by hand, with no record of which sources arrived after the last rewrite. A citation to a paper that is not yet in the wiki is lost as prose in `## Open questions` and never becomes a graph edge when that paper is ingested later. Corrections leave no trace of why a claim was wrong.

**Approach:** Adopt the two-zone page pattern (compiled zone rewritten on demand, append-only dated timeline) on topic pages, with the cheap append automated at ingest finalize and the synthesis kept user-invoked. Record unresolved citations as structured data and drain them deterministically when the cited work arrives. Log correction causes and surface tension candidates during topic refresh. No background workers, no embeddings, no database.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** Write through `atomicWrite`; validate slugs through the existing path-safety helpers; keep `wiki.mjs` the only mutation path; keep every new command idempotent; write timeline entries in English regardless of `document_output_language`; write the reverse edge in the same operation as the forward edge; preserve `<!-- user-edited -->` regions; keep lint finding IDs and JSON shapes backward compatible; keep skill `description:` frontmatter unchanged.

**Ask First:** Any new required frontmatter field, any change to existing lint severities, any automatic rewrite of a compiled zone, any change to `citations.jsonl` row shape.

**Never:** Edit or delete an existing timeline entry; add a daemon, cron, queue, or file watcher; add a dependency; auto-apply a `challenges` edge without user confirmation; touch `raw/`; let `--dry-run` write.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|---------------|----------------------------|----------------|
| First timeline entry | Topic page has no timeline markers | Append `## Timeline` heading plus open/close markers at end of body, entry inside; `updated` set to today; `compiled_at` untouched | — |
| Repeat entry | Identical line already inside the markers (`correction`/`note`); or, for `ingest` with `--source`, ANY existing line already recording an ingest entry for that source, regardless of date/text | No write; `{added:false, reason:'entry already exists'}` (or `'ingest entry for this source already exists'` for the ingest+source case) exit 0 | — |
| Entry with source | `--source sources/<s>` given | Line carries `[[sources/<s>]]`; `includes_source` edge topic→source and its reverse written via existing add-edge path (no-op if present) | Source file missing → exit 2 |
| Bad kind / date | `--kind foo` or `--date 2026-13-01` | No write | Exit 2 with message |
| Missing topic | Slug not under `topics/` | No write | Exit 2 |
| Stale topic | Timeline has an entry dated after `compiled_at`, or `compiled_at` absent and timeline non-empty | L21 warning, not fixable | Lint exit 0 when no errors |
| Fresh topic | Newest entry date ≤ `compiled_at`, or region empty/absent | No L21 finding | — |
| Cite known work | `add-citation-by-id <from> doi 10.x/y` and a source page carries that `external_ids.doi` | `add-citation from→that page`; `{resolved:true, to}` | — |
| Cite unknown work | No source carries the id | Append `{ns, value, title?}` to `from`'s `pending_citations` (dedupe on ns+value); `updated` bumped; `{resolved:false, pending:true}` | Invalid id → exit 2, no write |
| Drain on ingest | `resolve-pending-citations sources/<new>`; old pages carry pending entries matching any of `<new>`'s `external_ids` | For each match: citation old→new added, entry removed from old page, old `updated` bumped; `{resolved:[...], scanned:N}` | `--dry-run` reports without writing |
| Drain, no match | No pending entry matches | `{resolved:[], scanned:N}` exit 0 | — |
| Correction edit | `/lumi-edit` changes a factual claim | One question: cause is `misread`, `source-error`, or `update`; log line carries `cause:<value>`; if the page is a source inside a topic, a `correction` timeline entry is appended to each such topic | — |
| Topic refresh | User picks refresh | Compiled zone rewritten from key sources plus timeline; timeline zone byte-identical; `compiled_at` set to today; candidate list = current `key_sources` ∪ sources with `includes_source` edges; up to five tension pairs proposed, each confirmed before `add-edge … challenges …` | — |
| Ask | `/lumi-ask` with `wiki/topics/` present | Compiled zones of matching topics read before source pages; timeline read only for "what changed / when" questions | — |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Contract

### `schemas.mjs` (done)

- `TIMELINE_MARKER_OPEN = '<!-- lumina:timeline -->'`, `TIMELINE_MARKER_CLOSE = '<!-- /lumina:timeline -->'`, `TIMELINE_KINDS = ['ingest','correction','note']`.
- `topics` gains optional `compiled_at` (iso-date). `sources` gains optional `pending_citations` (array of `{ns, value, title?}`; `ns` ∈ `EXTERNAL_ID_NAMESPACES`, `value` normalized by `normalizeExternalId`).

### `wiki.mjs` new subcommands

```
timeline-add <topic-slug> --text "<text>" [--source <source-slug>] [--kind ingest|correction|note] [--date YYYY-MM-DD]
  (use --text=<text> when the text itself begins with --)
add-citation-by-id <from-source-slug> <ns> <value> [--title "<title>"]
resolve-pending-citations <new-source-slug> [--dry-run]
```

Timeline line format, one line, English:

```
- **YYYY-MM-DD** | <kind> | [[sources/<slug>]] — <text>
- **YYYY-MM-DD** | <kind> | <text>                     (no --source)
```

Entries are appended in arrival order (newest last), inserted immediately before the close marker. When the open marker exists but the close marker is missing, the zone runs to end of file and the close marker is added. Region created on demand as:

```
## Timeline

<!-- lumina:timeline -->
- **2026-09-16** | ingest | [[sources/attention-is-all-you-need]] — Self-attention replaces recurrence
<!-- /lumina:timeline -->
```

`timeline-add` output: `{"added":true|false,"topic":"topics/<slug>","line":"…","edge":"added"|"exists"|"none"}`.
`add-citation-by-id` output: `{"resolved":true,"to":"sources/<slug>"}` or `{"resolved":false,"pending":true,"added":true|false}`.
`resolve-pending-citations` output: `{"resolved":[{"from","to","ns","value"}],"scanned":N,"dryRun":bool}`.

All three follow the existing exit-code contract (0 / 2 user / 3 internal) and the `{"error","code"}` stderr envelope.

### `lint.mjs`

- New `L21-topic-timeline-stale`, severity `warning`, `fixable:false`, only for files under `topics/`. Message: `topic summary is behind its timeline: <N> new entries since <compiled_at|never>; refresh it with /lumi-research-topic <slug>`.
- Parse entry dates from lines matching `^- \*\*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})\*\* \|` inside the marker region. Compare with string `>` on ISO dates. Same-day entries are not stale.
- Add `L21` to `ALL_CHECK_IDS`; `by_check` and `checks_run` pick it up automatically.
- New `L22-pending-citations`, severity `info`, `fixable:false`, only for files under `sources/` with a non-empty `pending_citations`. Lists up to three entries (title or `ns:value`). Added after code review so pending citations never disappear from the visible record.

### Skills

- `ingest/references/step-01-draft.md`: Phase 6 uses `add-citation-by-id` whenever the cited work has a DOI/arXiv/S2/OpenAlex/URL id; prose in `## Open questions` only for citations with no identifier. New Phase 7.5 (only when `wiki/topics/` exists): for each concept edge the new source has, read `covered_by_topic` edges; collect topics; write `topics: [...]` into the checkpoint; show "Topics touched: <t> (via <concepts>)" in the Draft Gate summary.
- `ingest/references/step-04-finalize.md`: new Phase 8.7 before Log: `resolve-pending-citations sources/<slug>`; then for each checkpoint topic, `timeline-add topics/<t> --kind ingest --source sources/<slug> --text "<one-line key claim, English>"`. Log line and report mention counts.
- `research/topic/SKILL.md`: page shape is compiled zone + timeline zone; new pages get an empty timeline region and `compiled_at` = today; refresh reads the timeline, rewrites the compiled zone wholesale, never touches the timeline, sets `compiled_at`, reconciles candidates (confirm each; dropped → `remove-edge`), proposes tension pairs (confirm each → `add-edge sources/A challenges sources/B` and a `note` timeline entry).
- `core/edit/SKILL.md`: correction cause question and log format `corrected <slug> | cause:<misread|source-error|update> | <what>`; `correction` timeline entry for each topic the source belongs to.
- `core/ask/SKILL.md`: read topic compiled zones first; cite as `[[topics/<slug>]]`.
- `core/check/SKILL.md` and `references/lint-checks.md`: L21 row and the manual-correction list.

### Templates and docs

- `page-templates.md`: Topic block gains `compiled_at`; `## Timeline` section with markers, entry format, rewrite/append rule. Source block gains `pending_citations` (optional, commented).
- `src/templates/README.md`, `README.vi.md`, `README.zh.md`: Topic row mentions the dated timeline of arrivals at the bottom of the page.
- `docs/project-context.md`: L21 row, three new subcommands, topic two-zone rule, fix stale sample edge names, list `reflections/**` in the exemption sentence. `CLAUDE.md`: lint check count sentence. `CHANGELOG.md`: Unreleased entry.

## Tasks & Acceptance

- [x] `wiki.mjs` -- `timeline-add`, `add-citation-by-id`, `resolve-pending-citations`, usage text, tests.
- [x] `lint.mjs` -- L21, L22, tests, `/lumi-check` references.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a topic and a finalized ingest touching one of its concepts, when finalize runs, then the topic carries one `ingest` timeline line, the `includes_source` edge and its reverse exist, and lint reports L21 for that topic until refresh sets `compiled_at`.
- Given source A with a pending citation to DOI X, when source B with `external_ids.doi = X` is finalized, then `citations.jsonl` contains A→B and A's pending list no longer contains X.
- Given `npm run test:all`, `npm run ci:idempotency`, `npm run ci:package`, then all pass.
- Given existing wikis with no timeline and no pending citations, then lint output is unchanged.

## Design Notes

Timeline entries are in English so that a wiki shared across languages keeps one evidence trail. The compiled zone follows `document_output_language` as before.

The `includes_source` edge is written at timeline time because a `[[source]]` link on a topic page must have its reverse in the same operation (rule 11). Membership was shown at the Draft Gate, so it is user-confirmed; refresh is where the user may drop it.

Same-day staleness is not detected: an entry appended after a refresh on the same date waits until the next day to be flagged. Acceptable for a manual refresh cadence.
